conclusions.generator: Official 6/6 versus current 5/6 completed in the fixed original 12-attempt cohort. Exact current 4TP/0FP/0FN versus plain 3TP/9FP/1FN includes one same-mechanism taxonomy coding mismatch; no recall-lift claim. One synthetic Playwright app-fault case and its assertion mutation were evaluator-executed, not autonomous full workflow evidence.

conclusions.cypress: New V2/V3 runtime NOT_RUN: binary verification succeeded but browser startup/report was not established within the bounded attempt. Not a detection failure.
conclusions.cli_and_hosts: Strict 26 checks passed with mocked model/auth and zero model calls. Separate actual Claude installed-Chrome host smoke passed; Codex defining-tool/native execution is supported by later generator evidence. Exact pinned-Claude live roundtrip remains unexecuted.

release_preparation_scope: Evidence packaging and truthful bounded claims do not establish general skill efficacy. Final intended file list, applicable CI/security and any later document checks are recorded separately. No release/publication action is asserted.
